seed.description: Per-project PRNG seed. Prefer a random value persisted by BLA — never reuse legacy fixed fingerprints such as bla-shield-seed-v1.

weaveDecoys.description: Opt-in structural weave decoys (Python customer-def / .pyc co_consts weave; JS AST weave already on). Parity with CLI --weave-decoys / MCP weave_decoys.

selfSeal.description: Opt-in self-seal / sibling-module integrity binding for JS/Node targets (issue #40.5). Parity with CLI --self-seal / MCP self_seal. For multi-artifact trees, bankrupt harden recommends this (selfSealRecommended) but never auto-enables for single-file projects.

wasmPreserveExports.description: WASM export names that must remain the public ABI when export rename runs at maximum/bankrupt (issue #40.3).

allowWasmClearParamCarriers.description: Allow bankrupt harden despite clear WASM param/cipher ASCII carriers (R3PARM/R3CIPH/R2SEAL-class; red-blue round-3). Default false.

allowStablePanelDeriveAbi.description: Keep stable __vaultPanelDerive_* ABI (skip rewrite). Default false — maximum/bankrupt rewrite to _blaPd_* (red-blue round-3).

allowPlaintextSeal.description: Allow bankrupt harden despite plaintext/reversible seal sidecars (red-blue round-2). Default false.

allowLaneIndependentGates.description: Allow harden/defend of lane-independent JS gates (issue #40.1). Default false.
